  const configUrl = "/a/elevar/static/configs/6407c2a79be5ea8fdd071cb5e4cbef13da294fb3/config.js";
  const config = (await import(configUrl)).default;
  const scriptUrl = config.script_src_app_theme_embed;

  if (scriptUrl) {
    const { handler } = await import(scriptUrl);

    const readDomLiquidSnippet = id => {
      const element = document.querySelector(`#${id}`);
      return JSON.parse(element?.textContent ?? "null");
    };

    const stripNullProperties = object => {
      return Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(object).filter(([_k, v]) => v !== null)
      );
    };

    const getLiquidSnippetsFromDom = () => {
      const cartData = readDomLiquidSnippet("elevar-cart-data");
      const user = readDomLiquidSnippet("elevar-user");
        
      return {
        cartData,
        user: { ...user, customer: stripNullProperties(user.customer) },
        isOnCartPage: cartData.isOnCartPage,
        collectionView: readDomLiquidSnippet("elevar-collection-view"),
        searchResultsView: readDomLiquidSnippet("elevar-search-results-view"),
        productView: readDomLiquidSnippet("elevar-product-view")
      };
    };

    await handler(config, getLiquidSnippetsFromDom());
  }

<section class="full"><h2>Artistry Tips</h2>
<div style="font-size: 16px;">
<p>Shake well. Blend onto clean, moisturized skin using the <a href="https://www.hauslabs.com/products/haus-labs-foundation-brush">Haus Labs Foundation Brush</a>, fingertips or a beauty sponge.</p>

<p style="margin-top: 20px;"><strong>How to use as a tint:</strong><br>
Warm up product with clean fingertips. Apply by starting at the center and spread to the outer perimeter of the face (like you’re applying skincare). Press & pat with fingertips in areas you desire more coverage.</p>

<p style="margin-top: 20px;"><strong>How to use as a contour:</strong><br>
Choose a shade 2-3 levels deeper than your foundation. Add a small amount to the edge of the brush, swipe product beneath your cheekbones and buff out.</p>
